text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I don't get this at aaaall!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's been like this for a while now,
staring down her assignment and groaning in frustration.
choice_data_list: What class is that assignment for?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...!
Um, it's for my race strategy class!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It covers the days I missed when I had a cold, so I'm really struggling...
Ah, b-but don't worry! I'll manage somehow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a look at the materials, it seems the assignment is to devise
a well-reasoned strategy tailored to specific race conditions.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Weather conditions: Heavy rain from 3 days to 2 days prior, clear on race day.
See supplementary sheet for rainfall amounts, turf types, and standard moisture levels—"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So I need to come up with a strategy for each track and date...
Umm, supplementary sheet, supplementary sheet...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. This one is European turf, and this one is Japanese turf.
Huh? Is overseeding the one where they're mixed together...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And this spot having a high moisture level means... Nghhh!
There are way too many factors to consider!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: U-Um, Trainer, what about this—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no no! Never mind, I'm okay!
There's no point if I just ask for the answer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might be tricky, but Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi should be able to figure it out.
She's had enough experience to work through this.
choice_data_list: Stay calm and look back on what you've learned so far.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (My experience... Does that mean someone taught me this before?)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Rain, turf, drainage... When did we talk about that stuff again?
Nghhh, remember, brain, remeeember!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *exhale*... Keep calm, Tsuyoshi...!
*Inhale*... All right!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Culvert drainage!
So racecourses have underground artificial drainage systems~.
choice_data_list: Right. A lot more tracks have them now, including Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So what was it, the moisture level? How wet the turf is.
This course dries out way faster than the numbers would suggest!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Everyone takes the inside for the shortest line so it gets torn up fast, and you'd think
after heavy rain it'd be unrunnable, but—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If culvert drainage dries it quickly, then instead of crowding the outside to avoid rough ground,
there might actually be a chance to win on the inside... is what you're saying!
choice_data_list: If rivals avoid it due to preconceived notions, it just might pay off.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That might turn out to be a killer strategy...
Ah, I gotta write this down!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Can we use the VR Umalator right now?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I've got my thoughts organized, but I won't know for sure
until I actually run it to test it out!
choice_data_list: Understood. I'll put in the request right away.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought...!
It's drier than I expected... At this rate, I can break out from the very inside!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right, gotta keep testing more things out like this!
Let's do thissss!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm all doooone...!
It took some time, but this should definitely work...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Whoa-whoa-whoa, it's almost dorm curfew...!
I completely lost track of time~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer!
I'm heading back now! Thanks for everything~!
choice_data_list: I already let the dorm head know, so calm down—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Owch?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I slammed right into that face-first... Th-That's so embarrassing~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer really is amazing!
Just one look and you already knew what you'd taught me before!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I'm panicking until someone calls out to me, I've still got a long way to go.
I need to get it together! Get a grip, Tsuyoshi-!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*cough!* *hack!* ...Whew, that was close. That one didn't count.
A reliable Tsuyoshi never panics.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'm gonna become someone everyone can count on!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I won't just be the one getting rescued!
This summer, I will definitely become someone dependable!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spoken with pure determination, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's vow
vanished into the indigo night sky.
